name: Entropy Lab
desc: A Shannon entropy lab: four outcome sliders drive the entropy, KL divergence from uniform and perplexity, with a probability bar chart and a sampling check.
controls: Four outcome-probability sliders, four presets (uniform/biased/skewed/certain), flip-100 and reset buttons; keys 1–4 load presets, F flips, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
